key: Saran, White & Kuper — Evidence and gap map of studies assessing the effectiveness of interventions for people with disabilities in LMICs || A corrigendum (DOI: 10.1002/cl2.1104) was published 12 July 2020, correcting the original article (DOI: 10.1002/cl2.1070, published 9 January 2020). The corrigendum changed the income-country breakdown: the original stated 'over half (n=49) the impact evaluations come from upper-middle income countries', the corrected version reads 'almost half (n=50) the impact evaluations come from lower-middle income countries, closely followed by upper-middle income countries (n=48).' No further update to the EGM itself was found beyond this 2020 corrigendum. The draft acknowledges the correction exists but states it could not be read, while drawing on the source in the body text
